# Addendum to dev/prod f71668fa0 review

Author reports an additional runtime discovery while preparing the corrective commit: `packages/shared/src/event-popper/port-discovery.ts:80` uses require('node:child_process') inside getProcessStartTime. In plain Node ESM, require is undefined; the catch returns null, silently skipping PID recycling detection. Vitest did not expose this. This helper pattern existed before the migration, but the per-port reader/QA/preflight safety relies on it, so do not claim recycling detection is proven in Node ESM from the passing Vitest suite alone.

Author is replacing it with a static import and aligning preflight with listServerInfo; reported fixture excludes a recycled3104entry and selects3114 after fix. No reviewer rerun of the author-reported failure. The original f71668fa0 BLOCK stands independently on partial staging, sidecar guard and QA selection; those are not cleared by this unlanded follow-up. Preserve corrective build and verify actual ESM stale-entry discovery in its exact-head follow-up review.
